title: Isle of the Dead
description:
Isle of the Dead is a timeless journey, starting from an everyday apartment towards our final destination, guided by Charon, ferryman of the Underworld. 

This VR experience is a loose recreation of the eponymous work painted in 1883 by the Swiss symbolist painter Arnold Böcklin. The famous masterpiece also inspired a symphonic poem by Rachmaninov, which makes a perfect soundtrack to accompany the experience. 



Isle of the Dead is part of the collection « ARTE TRIPS », a series of immersive VR experiences that take you into masterpieces from 16th to 20th century by well-known painters. 



• Best Story in VR at Venice Film Festival 2018

• Audience Award at Entrevues Belfort 2018 

• Special Jury VR award at FilmGate Miami 2018 

• Best Virtual Reality Short Film at China International New Media Short Film Festival 



A VR experience directed by Benjamin Nuel

Written by Benjamin Nuel et Clémence Madeleine-Perdrillat

A coproduction Les Produits Frais, ARTE France.

With the participation of CNC – New Media Fund



Length: 8 minutes
description_short: Step into Böcklin’s masterpiece, in an award-winning VR experience. ISLE OF THE DEAD is a timeless, fascinating journey towards our final destination, guided by Charon, ferryman of the Underworld.
